body: Advisory Commission on Aging - Special Meeting
agenda_text:
ADVISORY COMMISSION ON AGING AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 12, 2026
  4321 ATLANTIC AVENUE
  EXPO ARTS CENTER, 10:00 AM

Judi Clarke, Chair  Clarice Kavanaugh, Commissioner
Sylvia Salcedo, Vice Chair  Justin Potier, Commissioner
Norma Chinchilla, Commissioner  Phyllis Schmidt, Commissioner
Catherine Francis, Commissioner  Harold Sutherland, Commissioner
Carolyn Hines, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  Irene.Rodriguez@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55797  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Advisory Commission on Aging
  meeting of Wednesday, July 8, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55829  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Long Beach Fire
  Department regarding evacuation and fire safety.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55830  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Disaster
  Preparedness and Emergency Communications Department regarding evacuation
  and emergency notifications during major disasters.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-55815  Recommendation to receive and file Superintendent’s Update on department
  business.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-55817  Recommendation to review, discuss, and, if appropriate, approve the City of Long
  Beach Advisory Commission on Aging 2026 Visibility Plan from the 2026 Visibility
  Plan Ad Hoc Committee.

6.  26-55798  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-55828  Recommendation to review, discuss, and, if appropriate, approve the Advisory
  Commission on Aging Mission Statement.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-55818  Recommendation to review, discuss, and, if appropriate, approve the Advisory
  Commission on Aging brochure and flyers.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Advisory Commission on Aging on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Rosa Garibay, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Irene Rodriguez at (562) 570-3538 or
Irene.Rodriguez@longbeach.gov.
